top5.title: 商汤发布 SenseNova Loop-9B 模型：部署显存需求低至 10 GB 内
top5.summary: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，商汤科技今天（17 日）晚间正式发布 SenseNova Loop-9B 模型。 该模型 延续了 Preview 版本对参数效率的探索 ：通过 Loop 结构复用模型层的参数，并结合流形约束超连接（mHC），在约 9B 参数规模下扩展计算深度，面向复杂推理、代码、工具调用和多模态任务。 模型得益于 Loop 的高效循环结构， 官方 4bit 量化后权重仅约 4.9GB ，部署显存需求低至 10 GB 内，能显著拓宽可部署的硬件范围， 让低显存芯片获得前沿 27B 级别模型性能成为可能 。 SenseNova Loop-9B 总参数量约为 9B。模型通过两次执行共享的中间层，将 32 个物理解码层扩展为 56 次层计算；支持文本、图像输入和文本输出， 上下文长度最高可达 512K
top5.title_zh: 商汤发布 SenseNova Loop-9B 模型：部署显存需求低至 10 GB 内

top5.title_en: SenseTime releases SenseNova Loop-9B with deployment memory under 10 GB
top5.summary_en: SenseTime officially released the SenseNova Loop-9B model, continuing the Preview version's exploration of parameter efficiency: it reuses layer parameters via a Loop structure and combines manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC) to extend computational depth at about 9B parameters, targeting complex reasoning, code, tool calling and multimodal tasks. The company says 4-bit quantized weights are only about 4.9GB, with deployment memory needs as low as 10 GB. By executing shared intermediate layers twice, the model expands 32 physical decoder layers into 56 layer computations; it supports text and image input with text output and context up to 512K.

top5.what_en: According to IT之家's publication dated 2026-11-17, SenseTime released SenseNova Loop-9B, which reuses layer parameters via a Loop structure plus manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC) to extend compute depth at about 9B parameters. SenseTime claims 4-bit weights of about 4.9GB, deployment memory under 10 GB, and up to 512K context (limited to the source-reported comparison scope; not independently verified).
